prTitle: Initial Project Setup and Environment Configuration
prBody:
This PR initializes the project structure and cleans up the default Vite template. 

Key changes:
- Established a clean folder structure (\`hooks\`, \`db\`, \`types\`).
- Created an \`env.ts\` module for environment variable management.
- Removed default assets and simplified \`App.tsx\` with a basic placeholder.
- Updated \`TASKLIST.md\` to reflect completion of the first phase.
notes: Project structure is now ready for Drizzle schema definition.
